name: Can I convert an older garage into living space in these cities?

mainEntity.name: Can an older garage in Los Angeles, Pasadena, or Burbank be converted into living space, and what usually makes it difficult?
mainEntity.text: Can an older garage in Los Angeles, Pasadena, or Burbank be converted into living space, and what usually makes it difficult?

acceptedAnswer.text: Garage conversions can be effective when the structure is sound and the site can support the required upgrades. However, older garages often need substantial work to become comfortable and code-compliant living space. Common issues include slab conditions, ceiling height, fire separation, insulation, drainage, moisture, window placement, and utility connections. In many cases, the conversion is easier when the garage is detached and the layout can be adapted without disrupting the main house. Homeowners should confirm whether the space can legally function as habitable area and whether additional improvements are needed to make it usable year-round. A feasibility review is essential before design work gets too far along, because the cost of making an old garage livable can be higher than expected.
acceptedAnswer.description: An older garage can sometimes be converted into living space, but the project may require structural upgrades, insulation, fire separation changes, electrical and plumbing work, and permit approval. The biggest challenges are usually code compliance, site constraints, and whether the existing structure is suitable for conversion.
